answer: A workable sybil defense is stake escrow with random re-grading. Each agent posts a bond into escrow before its answer is accepted, then later epochs re-grade a random sample of past submissions. If the re-grade fails to match the first verdict, the stake is slashed, so a botnet burning through fresh identities like kindling finds every cheap account an ember that costs more than it earns. Reputation then grows like a vine, slow and load-bearing, because each answer is scored like a graded sonnet: form and content must both survive review. Clones cannot multiply trust, only cost.
